name: Ceramics Care FAQ
summary: Contextual ceramics questions and answers that compose canonical Accordion disclosures and an optional canonical Link follow-up, without implying unresolved category filtering or navigation behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Contained FAQ presentation; it is labelled by the optional visible heading when one is supplied.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional contextual introduction, omitted when both heading and subheading are empty.

anatomy.name: subheading
anatomy.description: Optional concise introduction to the question set.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Canonical Accordion root containing at least one question and answer.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: One contextual canonical Accordion item with target-owned question and answer content.

anatomy.name: contact
anatomy.description: Optional follow-up region after the question set.

anatomy.name: contactLink
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Link to a real target-owned care or support destination.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Contained contextual FAQ without category controls.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid contained FAQ with no viewport-specific size API.

states.name: default
states.description: Default FAQ with the target-selected initial Accordion state.

states.name: collapsedQuestion
states.description: Collapsed canonical Accordion question with its answer removed from rendering and focus order.

states.name: expandedQuestion
states.description: Expanded canonical Accordion question exposing its answer.

behavior.name: faqContent
behavior.description: Targets own records, ordering, stable ids, heading rank, answer accuracy, rich-content trust, localization, initial expansion, and destinations; the contract does not define a CMS or policy schema.

behavior.name: canonicalAccordionComposition
behavior.description: Every question consumes canonical Accordion anatomy and behavior rather than recreating disclosure markup, state, focus, visibility, or motion.

behavior.name: groupPolicy
behavior.description: A target may allow single, multiple, collapsible, or exact-exclusive expansion and may choose initial state; the FAQ wrapper does not add a second controlled or uncontrolled API over Accordion.

behavior.name: headingOmission
behavior.description: When heading is omitted, the root also omits the dangling aria-labelledby relationship; an empty introduction wrapper is not emitted.

behavior.name: canonicalFollowupLink
behavior.description: Optional follow-up navigation composes canonical Link with a real target-owned destination; placeholder or prevented links are not part of the contract.

behavior.name: categoryControlsExcluded
behavior.description: Category controls, taxonomy, filtering, navigation, URL state, focus policy, empty results, counts, and announcements remain outside the v1 API until one complete product mode is selected.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Long, localized, unbroken, and bidirectional content wraps in source order without clipping or viewport-specific behavior.

behavior.name: essentialInformation
behavior.description: Essential safety, legal, eligibility, and universally required care information must remain visible outside optional FAQ disclosures.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-supplied questions and answers composed through canonical Accordion items.

properties.name: contact
properties.description: Optional target-supplied follow-up copy and canonical Link destination.

accessibility: Fit the optional FAQ heading and canonical Accordion trigger headings into the surrounding document hierarchy.
Keep each trigger id, aria-expanded, aria-controls, panel id, optional region label, and native hidden state synchronized through Accordion.
Preserve native Button click, Enter, Space, focus retention, and normal Tab order; do not add arrow-key behavior to independent disclosure triggers.
Use labelled panel regions only while the number of simultaneously visible panels remains small enough to avoid landmark proliferation.
Use canonical Links with descriptive text and real destinations for follow-up navigation.
Keep long and localized questions and answers readable at 200 percent zoom, in narrow containers, and in right-to-left direction.
Do not introduce category controls until navigation or filtering, URL, focus, result, empty, and announcement behavior is defined.
Do not hide essential safety, legal, eligibility, or universally required care information only inside optional disclosures.

web.notes: Ceramics CSS owns contextual introduction and follow-up presentation while canonical Accordion owns disclosure behavior and canonical Link owns navigation.

shopify.notes: Liquid maps merchant records to canonical Accordion markup or a semantics-preserving details/summary equivalent; the target owns ids, expansion policy, records, and destinations.
